subject.title: Feature request: per-pattern session maintenance retention rules

question: Should OpenClaw add public `session.maintenance.rules` for ordered per-pattern or per-type age retention, and what stable matcher contract should it expose?
rationale: The request adds public config and destructive cleanup semantics, so automation cannot safely choose raw key globs versus typed session-kind or metadata matching without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Approve typed retention rules
options.body: Add ordered first-match rules using stable typed criteria, with global `pruneAfter` fallback and explicit preservation semantics.

options.title: Approve raw key patterns
options.body: Implement glob-style key matching close to the request, accepting the compatibility cost of exposing session-key internals as config API.

options.title: Defer broad rules
options.body: Avoid a broad retention-rules surface for now and handle only narrower exact-preservation or fixed-kind cleanup cases.

recommendation.title: Approve typed retention rules
recommendation.body: Add ordered first-match rules using stable typed criteria, with global `pruneAfter` fallback and explicit preservation semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current session-maintenance helper ownership and repository config policy make this the best available product-direction routing candidate.
